author: ViolentBoo
body:
Just thought of a few things that could help improve game-play or just make the game better as it is:

-Immediately when the last monument broken, everyone on the losing team dies for a *dramatic* effect but will not count toward your kills/deaths.

-FOR THE LOVE OF GOD MAKE THE MAPS START OFF WITH 64 WOOD NOT 32.

-Fix like half the maps idk lol

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
We've gone over this several times and nobody ever pays attention. It's already gone and has been gone, the only 2 maps that periodically come on are Siege and Zao. The mapdevs have already phased out the maps from the DTM rots and instead we have made a compromise that will come out in the next update.

As for the wood amount, it depends on the mapmaker. It's not entirely our control.
